name: Ring of Inspired Performance
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Slot ring; Price 2,500 gp; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This fancy gold ring typically has musical or theatric images worked into its design. It grants the wearer a +5 competence bonus to any Perform skill check.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Forge Ring, Perform 5 ranks, ring of at least 250 gp in value; Cost 1,250 gp

Identification DC 20
